_comment: 782/789 ok on the manifold engine, which the app defaults to. Measured with a 300s per-file cap: that cap is a hang guard, not a performance budget, and the app's own model budget is set 30s below it so a runaway is named rather than timing out anonymously. Every remaining failure has a cause: three include files missing from the vendored sources, one model over the 5M vertex cap, two that exceed the call stack, and one that really does run past 270s. Diff future runs against failures[], not against zero.
